Blue Archive is a game that draws you in with cute anime girls and seemingly funny stories about said girls. However, once you start playing through the main story, and reading through the character stories of each girl you are given, you realize the world these girls live in is one with deep lore and a somewhat dark history behind it and in the background. There's many things wrong with the world in the background, but in the forefront of things, Sensei (You) are a shining light and beacon for these girls who seek to always live in the best world they can live in. Sensei may be a dumbfuck of a brick at times, and certainly isn't the best example of an adult around younger people, but he certainly always tries his best despite his downsides to try and be the best person he can be for the students around him.

In short, Sensei is the standard all-around-good gacha protagonist who happens to have a not-Harem of student girls who have varying levels of affection for Sensei...
